name: whats-running-mcp
description: What is ACTUALLY running on this machine — read live from the OS, never from stale docs or memory.
long_description: Answers "what is live right now?" from the operating system itself — ps, lsof, launchctl/systemctl, df — never from transcripts, memory files, or documentation. Reports AI-agent sessions (terminal-attached vs detached, with pid, uptime and working directory), every TCP port in LISTEN state with its owning process, loaded daemons (non-Apple launchctl jobs on macOS, running systemd user services on Linux), and load/uptime/root-disk stats. Includes a one-call whats_running snapshot for grounding a session at start. Read-only by construction: every command is a fixed binary with fixed flags; nothing derived from model input is ever passed to a shell.
